content:
q17.

`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`

- The module is the TanStack Query data-access layer for memos: query hooks `useMemos`, `useInfiniteMemos`, `useMemo`, `useLinkMetadata`, `useMemoComments`, `useInfiniteMemoComments` and mutation hooks `useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo`, plus the `memoKeys` cache-key factory and optimistic list-patching helpers (`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:12`, `:112`, `:178`, `:197`, `:253`).
- Every RPC goes through the generated Connect client `memoServiceClient`, imported from `@/connect` (`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:5`); it is created from the generated `MemoService` descriptor at `web/src/connect.ts:197` (`createClient(MemoService, transport)`), with `MemoService` generated in `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts:1237`.
- Related but separate slices: memo shares live in `web/src/hooks/useMemoShareQueries.ts`, editor-side create/update orchestration in `web/src/components/MemoEditor/services/memoService.ts`, and reactions in `web/src/components/MemoReactionListView/hooks.ts` — all using the same `memoServiceClient`.
